name: Sentou
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood public bathhouse (Benten-yu): a bath-fee change notice, a first day working part-time at the front desk, an hours-and-fees guide, a locker-key switch to IC cards, a first-timer's manners guide, a lesson in rephrasing the difference between two kinds of baths simply, a locker mix-up and the lesson it teaches, the shop's history of switching from wooden locker tags to IC cards, a multi-use ticket guide, a column on the debate behind allowing photography of the mural, a hybrid paper-stamp-plus-app loyalty guide, a reflection on balancing speed and warmth as unmanned bathhouses spread, and a sixtieth-anniversary report. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
